Math.round(e.getBoundingClientRect().width) : null; return {banner: b ? b.className + ' ' + r(b) : null, content: r(document.getElementById('k_takeaway')), vw: window.innerWidth}; })()

['w_atm','w_land','w_ocean'].map(i => { const e = document.getElementById(i).parentElement; const b = e.getBoundingClientRect(); return i + ' top ' + Math.round(b.top + scrollY) + ' h ' + Math.round(b.height); })
Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a')).filter(a => /Copy link/.test(a.innerText)).slice(0,1).map(a => { const r = a.getClientRects(); return a.innerText + ' rects ' + r.length; })

(() => { const b = document.getElementById('s_go').getBoundingClientRect(); const p = document.getElementById('f_plot').getBoundingClientRect(); const t = document.getElementById('f_takeaway').getBoundingClientRect(); return {button_y: Math.round(b.top + scrollY), takeaway_y: Math.round(t.top + scrollY), plot_y: Math.round(p.top + scrollY), plot_bottom: Math.round(p.bottom + scrollY)}; })()

(() => { const t = document.getElementById('f_takeaway').getBoundingClientRect(); return {scrollY: Math.round(scrollY), takeaway_top_in_viewport: Math.round(t.top), takeaway_text: document.getElementById('f_takeaway').innerText.slice(0, 200)}; })()
